siblings.purpose: A reusable launchpad for organization-owned implementations: the exported kit (control-plane scripts, the compiled runtime and the harness bundle) with the instance's own orders, evidence and overlays. Public under core's license files (Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0 for documentation, NOTICE), never exported with --license none; anyone may fork it; it holds no orders of its own. The operator's personal instance and work instance are forks of it, registered nowhere in this registry [operator direction, 2026-10-11]. An operator-stated intention, not an inspected implementation claim.

Three purposes [operator direction, 2026-10-11]: the reference for the architecture the operator wants Angular applications to follow (Angular, Nx, NgRx Signal Store with events and Transloco, as product 03 records); the demonstration that an instance builds another repository through the workflow; and a console for DotLn over the uifa-board-v1 view model. Public under core's license posture; a registered target of the operator's personal instance, never an export destination and never used at work; early work is foundational, and visual output verifies that things work. An operator-stated intention, not an inspected implementation claim.
